author: MLG_Jirafa
body:
The title can explain itself, do you have any idea to attract donators? I have been reading a lot of the Eula on the mojang's official site, so there is a lot of things that I recommend
Things that have to go:
XP boost (it affects gameplay)
Donor Kits
Join full teams
/surface
New ideas:
exclusive matches
hats or something related
Avicus official RP download
/random to join a random match
Leaderboards post-match
/stats to show the stats of that match
And yeah I ran out of ideas so comment below some of your ideas to improve the server donations
Other Players ideas:
